Automation Cloud Administration and Test.summary: Administration updates include 30-day in-app notification retention, bulk AI and Agentic usage top-ups, a shared monthly AI and Agentic usage pool, and Transactional Billing for Maestro-orchestrated agentic solutions.

changes.name: In-app notification retention limit
changes.summary: In-app notifications are retained for 30 days; older notifications are unavailable regardless of topic.
changes.analysis: This establishes a fixed retention period for cloud-environment notifications. Organizations that need older notification history may need to account for the 30-day availability limit.
changes.impact: Progressively rolling out across regions and applies only to cloud environments; notifications older than 30 days are no longer available.

changes.name: Multiple AI and Agentic usage top-ups
changes.summary: Administrators can grant multiple AI and Agentic usage top-ups to a user in one action from the User usage dashboard, with each top-up recorded as a separate consumption event.
changes.analysis: This streamlines allocation of multiple top-ups while retaining separate consumption-event records.
changes.impact: Administrators can issue more than one top-up in a single action and review each as an individual consumption event.

changes.name: Shared monthly AI and Agentic usage pool
changes.summary: User licenses now provide one monthly AI and Agentic usage pool shared by Autopilot, Agent Development, ScreenPlay Development, Conversational Agents, and Autopilot for Everyone, replacing separate per-product AI entitlements.
changes.analysis: This consolidates usage allocation and administration across the listed capabilities instead of managing separate product-specific AI entitlements.
changes.impact: Administrators grant top-ups and monitor per-user usage at Admin > Licenses > Consumables > User usage.

changes.name: Transactional Billing
changes.summary: Transactional Billing is a new charging model for agentic solutions orchestrated by Maestro; it packages a solution run into a single, tiered transaction cost.
changes.analysis: This introduces a billing model for Maestro-orchestrated agentic solutions. The provided release notes are truncated after the beginning of the cost-basis description, so further billing details are not stated.
changes.impact: A new charging model is available for applicable Maestro-orchestrated agentic solution runs.

Automation Cloud Administration and Test.overall_analysis: The administration changes centralize AI and Agentic usage management, add bulk top-up administration, establish notification retention, and introduce a billing model for Maestro-orchestrated agentic solutions.

Action Center.summary: Action Center adds an Outlook consent requirement, Validation Station compact-view field filtering, and public-preview Quick Form tasks.

changes.name: Microsoft Entra admin consent for Outlook actionable notifications
changes.summary: A one-time Microsoft Entra admin consent is required by August 26, 2026 for actionable notifications in Outlook to continue working, following Microsoft’s move away from legacy authentication for Actionable Messages.
changes.analysis: Administrators need to complete consent by the stated date to preserve Outlook actionable-notification functionality under the updated authentication approach.
changes.impact: Without the required one-time consent by August 26, 2026, actionable notifications in Outlook may not continue working.

changes.name: Validation Station compact-view filter bar
changes.summary: Validation Station compact view adds a filter bar that searches and hides fields by state: confirmed, not extracted, or no flagged issues.
changes.analysis: This helps users focus validation work on fields in selected states and locate fields more efficiently.
changes.impact: Compact-view users can filter and search fields by the listed states.

changes.name: Quick Form tasks
changes.summary: Quick Form tasks are available in public preview for adding human-in-the-loop tasks to Maestro BPMN, Case Management, Flow, or Agents processes without building or deploying an app; inline debug support is included.
changes.analysis: This provides a lower-overhead way to incorporate human tasks into the listed process types and supports debugging in context.
changes.impact: Public-preview feature; users can add qualifying human-in-the-loop tasks without building or deploying an app.

Action Center.overall_analysis: Action Center updates address Outlook authentication continuity, improve Validation Station field handling, and preview a simplified mechanism for human-in-the-loop tasks.

Agents.summary: Agents adds preview episodic and escalation memory, plus public-preview personal connections for conversational agents.

changes.name: Episodic and escalation memory
changes.summary: Agents can retain and reuse learning from past executions through episodic memory and from past escalation resolutions through escalation memory; the capability is available in preview.
changes.analysis: Memory may allow agents to use prior execution and escalation-resolution context in later work. The release notes designate the capability as preview.
changes.impact: Preview availability for episodic memory and escalation memory.

changes.name: Personal connections for conversational agents
changes.summary: Conversational agents support personal connections in public preview, enabling individual users to select which of their own Integration Service connections an agent uses on their behalf.
changes.analysis: This gives individual users control over the Integration Service connection used for their interactions with a conversational agent.
changes.impact: Public-preview availability; users can choose their own connection for supported agent use.

Agents.overall_analysis: The Agents changes expand personalization and reuse of past context, both with preview availability.

Integration Service.summary: Integration Service updates the Snowflake Cortex and Microsoft Azure AI Foundry connectors and makes the MCP connector generally available.

changes.name: Snowflake Cortex authentication methods
changes.summary: The Snowflake Cortex connector adds OAuth 2.0 Authorization code and Client credentials authentication alongside the existing Programmatic Access Token method.
changes.analysis: Additional authentication methods provide more supported ways to connect to Snowflake Cortex.
changes.impact: Users can choose OAuth 2.0 Authorization code, Client credentials, or the existing Programmatic Access Token method.

changes.name: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry Invoke Agent activity
changes.summary: The Microsoft Azure AI Foundry connector adds an Invoke Agent activity for agents created in the Azure AI Foundry portal.
changes.analysis: This enables connector-based invocation of agents created in the Azure AI Foundry portal.
changes.impact: A new activity is available for invoking applicable Azure AI Foundry agents.

changes.name: MCP connector general availability
changes.summary: The MCP connector is now generally available.
changes.analysis: The connector has moved from a prior availability state to general availability; no further details are stated.
changes.impact: The MCP connector is generally available.

Integration Service.overall_analysis: The Integration Service changes broaden connector authentication and agent invocation capabilities, while making the MCP connector generally available.

Maestro.summary: Maestro enhances Flow Autonomous Agent node MCP controls and adds two BPMN activities for Orchestrator queue interactions.

changes.name: Autonomous Agent node MCP tool controls
changes.summary: Maestro Flow Autonomous Agent nodes add per-argument descriptions, full input/output schema viewing, and a Refresh tools action that can pull tools live from Agent Hub.
changes.analysis: These controls improve visibility into MCP tool interfaces and allow tools to be refreshed from Agent Hub.
changes.impact: Users can inspect argument and schema information and refresh tools live from Agent Hub.

changes.name: Orchestrator queue BPMN activities
changes.summary: New Get queue items and Wait for queue event BPMN activities support read-only queries and blocking waits against Orchestrator queues.
changes.analysis: These activities enable BPMN processes to inspect queue items and wait for queue events without stated write capabilities.
changes.impact: Maestro BPMN workflows can perform read-only queue queries and blocking waits against Orchestrator queues.

Maestro.overall_analysis: Maestro gains improved MCP tool management in Flow and new BPMN integration patterns for Orchestrator queues.

Process Mining.summary: The UiPath data extractor data-loading option has been removed due to low adoption.

changes.name: Removal of UiPath data extractor data-loading option
changes.summary: The UiPath data extractor data-loading option has been removed due to low adoption; users should use another supported data-loading option.
changes.analysis: Users relying on this option must transition to one of the remaining supported data-loading options.
changes.impact: The removed data-loading option is no longer available.

Process Mining.overall_analysis: Process Mining removes a low-adoption data-loading option, requiring affected users to use an alternative supported option.

Studio Web.summary: Studio Web adds read-only solution access and makes Deploy the primary toolbar action for packaging and deployment.

changes.name: Read-only solutions
changes.summary: Solutions can be opened in read-only mode and shared with read-only access without granting edit permissions.
changes.analysis: This supports viewing and sharing solutions while limiting modification rights.
changes.impact: Users can open and share solutions with read-only access.

changes.name: Deploy toolbar action
changes.summary: Deploy is now the primary toolbar action for packaging and deploying a solution in one guided flow; Publish moved to the dropdown.
changes.analysis: The toolbar prioritizes the combined packaging-and-deployment workflow while retaining Publish in the dropdown.
changes.impact: The primary toolbar action changes to Deploy, and Publish is accessed from the dropdown.

Studio Web.overall_analysis: Studio Web improves permission control for solution access and shifts the main toolbar workflow toward guided packaging and deployment.

Test Manager.summary: Test Manager expands performance reporting and execution targeting, and removes iText PDF dependency with a stated breaking change for cloud PDF attachments.

changes.name: Performance Testing reporting and export enhancements
changes.summary: Performance Testing adds per-scenario report comparisons, dry-run probe timeline data in production, and asynchronous Excel export with per-custom-field columns.
changes.analysis: These additions expand comparison, production timeline, and export capabilities for performance-testing results.
changes.impact: Users can compare reports per scenario, access dry-run probe timeline data in production, and export asynchronously to Excel with columns for each custom field.

changes.name: Runtime configuration for autonomous runs
changes.summary: Autonomous Test Execution and Autonomous Exploration runs can target a specific runtime, robot account, and machine template through a new Configure tab rather than always auto-selecting an available runtime.
changes.analysis: This provides explicit infrastructure targeting for these runs instead of relying solely on automatic runtime selection.
changes.impact: Users can configure a runtime, robot account, and machine template for applicable runs.

changes.name: iText PDF dependency removal
changes.summary: The iText PDF library dependency was removed. Cloud reading of PDF attachments is now text-only, and image extraction from PDF attachments is no longer supported.
changes.analysis: The removal changes cloud PDF attachment handling by eliminating image extraction and limiting reading to text.
changes.impact: Cloud PDF attachment image extraction is unavailable; PDF attachment reading is text-only.

Test Manager.overall_analysis: Test Manager adds more control and reporting for testing workflows, while introducing an explicit breaking limitation for cloud PDF attachment processing.

IXP.summary: IXP adds a preview Layout model intelligent pre-processing option for Unstructured and Complex Documents projects.

changes.name: Layout model intelligent pre-processing
changes.summary: A Layout model intelligent pre-processing option is available in preview for Unstructured and Complex Documents projects.
changes.analysis: This adds a pre-processing option for the specified project types; the release notes do not state further behavior or benefits.
changes.impact: Preview availability for Unstructured and Complex Documents projects.

IXP.overall_analysis: IXP expands intelligent pre-processing options for the specified document project types in preview.
